Модель берёт кубик в симуляторе почти вс: A model picks up the cube in the simulator almost every time. Does that mean it will do the same on a real robot?
Да, если симулятор хороший: Yes, if the simulator is good
Нет: между симулятором и реальностью ест: No: there is a gap between the simulator and reality in light, colors, friction and delays
Нет, в реальности модели из симулятора н: No, models from a simulator don't work in reality at all
У Dactyl медиана 50 поворотов в симулято: Dactyl's median is 50 turns in the simulator and 13 on the hand, Tobin's detector has an error of 0.3–0.5 cm in the simulator and 1.5 cm on photos, and Ada gets 100% and 68%. Randomization and calibration narrow the gap but don't remove it.
Чтобы перенос из симулятора удался, карт: Does the image have to be photorealistic for transfer from a simulator to work?
Да, иначе модель не узнает реальный мир: Yes, otherwise the model won't recognize the real world
Нет: Тобин и соавторы учили детектор на: No: Tobin et al. trained a detector on unrealistic random textures, and the robot grasped the object in 38 attempts out of 40
Нет, картинка вообще не важна: No, the image doesn't matter at all
Рендерер MuJoCo, который они использовал: The MuJoCo renderer they used doesn't even try to be realistic. What matters is diversity: with fewer than 1,000 different textures, accuracy drops noticeably.
Чем шире рандомизация, тем лучше перенос: Does wider randomization always mean better transfer?
Да, реальный мир тогда точно окажется од: Yes, then the real world will surely be one of the variants
Нет: менять надо то, к чему модель должн: No: you should vary what the model should be indifferent to, and roughly within the real differences
На столе Ады краска любого цвета уронила: On Ada's table, paint of any color dropped success from 94% to 37%: red is the task. Dactyl's ranges were centered on measured values, and the full randomization cost 100 years of simulated experience instead of 3.
Если массы и трение руки точно измерены,: If the hand's masses and friction are measured precisely, is physics randomization unnecessary?
Нет: у Dactyl без рандомизации физики ме: No: without physics randomization, Dactyl's median fell from 13 turns to 2, even though the ranges were centered on calibrated values
Нет, но только для ног, не для рук: No, but only for legs, not for hands
Модель MuJoCo не знает, например, люфта: The MuJoCo model doesn't know about tendon backlash or delays, for example, and without the unmodeled effects the median was also 2. Observation noise is barely needed with accurate markers, but when the position is estimated from cameras, the median without it falls from 11.5 to 3.5.
Ткань, жидкости и тонкий контакт пальцев: Does a simulator compute fabric, liquids and fine finger contact as reliably as rigid bodies?
Да, современные движки считают всё одина: Yes, modern engines compute everything equally well
Нет: мягкое, жидкое и контакт многих пал: No: soft materials, liquids and the contact of many fingers are noticeably harder to simulate
Нет, такие задачи в симуляторе вообще не: No, such tasks can't be set up in a simulator at all
Isaac Lab и Genesis добавляют конечные э: Isaac Lab and Genesis add finite elements and particles, but the DreamGen authors explicitly name folding towels and wiping liquids as tasks that are difficult to simulate. The Dactyl hand never learned to rotate a sphere.
MimicGen придумывает новые движения робо: Does MimicGen invent new robot movements?
Да, генеративная модель рисует новые тра: Yes, a generative model draws new trajectories
Нет: он переносит куски записей оператор: No: it transfers segments of operator recordings to new object positions and adds straight-line moves; what is new are the placements
Нет, он просто повторяет записи без изме: No, it simply repeats the recordings unchanged
Каждая подзадача привязана к своему пред: Each subtask is tied to its object, and its segment shifts together with the object. That is why MimicGen needs the subtasks and the object poses, and why the tasks have to involve rigid objects.
Неудачные попытки генерации тоже стоит о: Is it worth keeping the failed generation attempts too, since that's more data?
Нет: модель учится и ошибкам; MimicGen о: No: the model learns the mistakes too; MimicGen keeps only the attempts that succeeded in the simulator

Демонстрации, сгенерированные MimicGen,: Are demonstrations generated by MimicGen noticeably worse than those recorded by people?
Да, синтетика всегда хуже: Yes, synthetic data is always worse
Нет: в большинстве задач 200 сгенерирова: No: in most tasks, 200 demonstrations generated from 10 human ones gave as much as 200 recorded by people
Плюс сгенерированных — их можно сделать: The advantage of generated demonstrations is that you can make as many as you like: from 200 to 1,000, success grew noticeably. But from 1,000 to 5,000, it barely changed, and synthetic data can't do without real data: in RoboCasa's real kitchen, it was added to 50 real demonstrations.
